text_en: To the leader: according to Lilies. Of David.
text_cn: 达味作，交与乐官，调寄"百合"。

text_en: Save me, O God, for the waters have come up to my neck.
text_cn: 天主，求你从速拯救我； 因大水已到我的颈脖。

text_en: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold; I have come into deep waters, and the flood sweeps over me.
text_cn: 我陷于泥泞中，没有立足的处所； 我沉入深水中，波涛已掩盖了我。

text_en: I am weary with my crying; my throat is parched. My eyes grow dim with waiting for my God.
text_cn: 我呼号得筋疲力竭，我已咽喉焦干； 我常期望我的天主，我已望眼欲穿。

text_en: More in number than the hairs of my head are those who hate me without cause; many are those who would destroy me, my enemies who accuse me falsely. What I did not steal must I now restore?
text_cn: 无故憎恨我的人，比我的头发更繁， 无理敌对我的人，比我的骨头更坚； 我没有抢夺过的，我反而应该偿还。

text_en: O God, you know my folly; the wrongs I have done are not hidden from you.
text_cn: 天主，我的愚昧，你知道得更为周详。 我的过犯，不能向你掩盖隐藏。

text_en: Do not let those who hope in you be put to shame because of me, O Lord God of hosts; do not let those who seek you be dishonored because of me, O God of Israel.
text_cn: 上主，万军的上主，愿那仰望你的人，不要因我而蒙羞， 以色列人的天主，愿那寻觅你的人，不要因我而受辱。

text_en: It is for your sake that I have borne reproach, that shame has covered my face.
text_cn: 因为，我为了你已饱受欺凌， 羞愧已经笼罩了我的面容。

text_en: I have become a stranger to my kindred, an alien to my mother’s children.
text_cn: 连我的兄弟们都以我为外宾， 我母亲的儿子都拿我当客人。

text_en: It is zeal for your house that has consumed me; the insults of those who insult you have fallen on me.
text_cn: 我对你殿宇所怀的热忱把我耗尽， 并且那侮辱你者的辱骂落于我身。

text_en: When I humbled my soul with fasting, they insulted me for doing so.
text_cn: 我含泪斋戒克己苦身， 竟成了我受辱的原因；

text_en: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.
text_cn: 我身上穿着麻布当作衣裳， 也竟成了他们取笑的对象。

text_en: I am the subject of gossip for those who sit in the gate, and the drunkards make songs about me.
text_cn: 闲坐门口的人，对我议论纷纷， 喝醉烈酒的人，对我歌唱戏弄。

text_en: But as for me, my prayer is to you, O Lord . At an acceptable time, O God, in the abundance of your steadfast love, answer me. With your faithful help
text_cn: 上主，在这困厄的时日， 我只有求救于你； 天主，求你按你丰厚的慈爱应允我， 求你以你救援的忠诚俯听我。

text_en: rescue me from sinking in the mire; let me be delivered from my enemies and from the deep waters.
text_cn: 求你救我于污泥中，不要让我沉没。 救我脱离恨我的人，走出大水旋涡，

text_en: Do not let the flood sweep over me, or the deep swallow me up, or the Pit close its mouth over me.
text_cn: 求你不要让波浪淹没我，深渊吞灭我， 也不要让地窖合上自己的口埋葬我。

text_en: Answer me, O Lord , for your steadfast love is good; according to your abundant mercy, turn to me.
text_cn: 上主，求你照你和蔼的慈爱俯允我， 求你按你深厚的仁慈眷顾我。

text_en: Do not hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress—make haste to answer me.
text_cn: 求你不要向你的仆人隐藏你的慈颜， 因为我正处在困厄中，求你从速垂怜。

text_en: Draw near to me, redeem me, set me free because of my enemies.
text_cn: 求你亲近我的灵魂，施予救赎， 为了我的诸般仇敌，求你救护。

text_en: You know the insults I receive, and my shame and dishonor; my foes are all known to you.
text_cn: 我受的侮辱、欺凌和耻笑，你都识穿； 欺凌迫害我的众人，都在你的眼前。

text_en: Insults have broken my heart, so that I am in despair. I looked for pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.
text_cn: 侮辱破碎了我心，使我忧伤难过； 我期望有人同情，却未寻到一个， 我渴盼有人安慰，也未找到一个。

text_en: They gave me poison for food, and for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
text_cn: 他们在我的食物中，搀上了苦胆， 我口渴时，竟递来酸醋要我下咽，

text_en: Let their table be a trap for them, a snare for their allies.
text_cn: 愿他们的筵席变成网罗， 为同席的友人变为圈套！

text_en: Let their eyes be darkened so that they cannot see, and make their loins tremble continually.
text_cn: 愿他们的眼睛昏迷失明， 使他们的双腰颤抖不停！

text_en: Pour out your indignation upon them, and let your burning anger overtake them.
text_cn: 求你向他们倾泄你的盛怒， 让你的怒火把他们笼罩住。

text_en: May their camp be a desolation; let no one live in their tents.
text_cn: 愿他们的居所变成荒土， 愿他们的帐幕无人再住！

text_en: For they persecute those whom you have struck down, and those whom you have wounded, they attack still more.
text_cn: 因为他们继续打击你所打击的人， 他们另加苦害你所伤残的人。

text_en: Add guilt to their guilt; may they have no acquittal from you.
text_cn: 愿你在他们的罪罚上增加罪罚， 不要使他们在你面前称义自夸。

text_en: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living; let them not be enrolled among the righteous.
text_cn: 愿他们从生命册上全被涂去， 不要让他们与义人同被录取：

text_en: But I am lowly and in pain; let your salvation, O God, protect me.
text_cn: 天主，我既贫乏而又忧苦， 愿你的救助赐给我卫护：

text_en: I will praise the name of God with a song; I will magnify him with thanksgiving.
text_cn: 我要用诗歌赞美天主的名号， 并要用感恩的心给天主增耀：

text_en: This will please the Lord more than an ox or a bull with horns and hoofs.
text_cn: 这将使上主满心欢愉， 胜于蹄角具全的牛犊。

text_en: Let the oppressed see it and be glad; you who seek God, let your hearts revive.
text_cn: 卑微的人们，你们要观看，并要喜庆， 寻求天主的人，你们的心必要兴奋，

text_en: For the Lord hears the needy, and does not despise his own that are in bonds.
text_cn: 因为对贫苦的人，上主常予俯听； 对他的俘虏，他决不会看轻。

text_en: Let heaven and earth praise him, the seas and everything that moves in them.
text_cn: 愿上天下地都歌颂赞美他， 海洋和一切水族都称扬他！

text_en: For God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah; and his servants shall live there and possess it;
text_cn: 因为天主要拯救熙雍，建造犹大的城池： 使他的仆人住在那里，并占有作为基地。

text_en: the children of his servants shall inherit it, and those who love his name shall live in it.
text_cn: 他仆人的后裔将要承继此邑， 爱慕他名的人也要住在这里。
